verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider, so inbox triage streams are a fair axis. However, the evidence shows no built-in categorization of mail into streams such as important, team, newsletters or calendar invites, and no priority-ordered triage. What it does document are adjacent building blocks: string labels a developer attaches to track conversation state, allow/block address lists, and the ability to create many separate inboxes. A developer could use these to build stream splitting, but they are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
